metas.name: Madraskaaran
metas.description: A minor argument between two strangers escalates into a life-altering conflict, exploring how a seemingly insignificant event can drastically alter a person's perception and circumstances.

metas.name: Mahasenha
metas.description: Mahasenha is a mythological jungle thriller set in the mystichills of Kurangani, where an ancient Yaali sculpture, worshipped by the tribal villagers as a divine protector, becomes the center of a high-stakes conflict. The film delivers a powerful message : Faith is not just belief-its protection.

metas.name: Mamta Child Factory
metas.description: Two small-town real estate agents help a city doctor establish a surrogacy hospital, battling local prejudices and traditional mindsets in their conservative community.

metas.name: Manada Kadalu
metas.description: "Manada Kadalu" is a coming-of-age love story. Sumukha, an MBBS dropout, pursues love interest Rashika. However, friend Anjali's influence leads him to self-discovery and reevaluating life's value.

metas.name: Maranamass
metas.description: An unlikely group of people become trapped on a bus with a man they do not realise is the serial killer terrorising their community.

metas.name: Mario
metas.description: While working underground to fix a water main, Brooklyn plumbers—and brothers—Mario and Luigi are transported down a mysterious pipe and wander into a magical new world. But when the brothers are separated, Mario embarks on an epic quest to find Luigi.

metas.name: Mark
metas.description: Mark is suspended from his police duties for his unruly yet effective ways of operating, but when 18 children are abducted and found dead, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.

metas.name: Mass Jathara
metas.description: A transport officer battles a violent drug lord and his criminal clan.

metas.name: Me No Pause Me Play
metas.description: Me No Pause Me Play is a heartwarming and empowering story of women navigating life's transitions, rediscovering their strength, and redefining identity beyond age, delivering a powerful message of awareness and acceptance around menopause.

metas.name: Mirage
metas.description: A woman joins forces with a journalist to investigate secrets her fiancé was keeping from her after she is informed he has died in a tragic train accident.

metas.name: Mirai
metas.description: Four-year-old Kun struggles with jealousy after his newborn sister, Mirai, begins receiving most of his family’s attention. Retreating to the garden, he encounters Mirai as a teenager from the future and embarks on extraordinary journeys across his family’s past, gradually discovering new perspectives on love, belonging and what it means to become an older brother.

metas.name: Mithada Maheman
metas.description: Distraught Aditya finds himself on a road trip with three strangers who offer different perspectives on his life.

metas.name: Mithra Mandali
metas.description: The lives of a group of misfit friends become chaotic after one of them falls for a politician's daughter.

metas.name: Mokshapatam
metas.description: Mokshapatam Gayatri is a middle-class woman working as a floor manager at a hotel. She has dreams of giving a better life to her kid and making a decent living with her savings until her family loses money to her husband's friend, who dies in an accident. On a fateful day, she discovers a bag forgotten by a customer in the hotel room. Will this bag change her fate or throw her into more problems? Watch now!

metas.name: Moonwalk
metas.description: It's the year 1987. Youngsters living in the outskirts of Thiruvananthapuram start exploring breakdancing.

metas.name: Narivetta
metas.description: A police officer uncovers a conspiracy based around state-sanctioned violence against victimized villagers.

metas.name: Not All Movies Are the Same Dual
metas.description: After losing everything to a personal mistake, a young man stumbles into a parallel world where a family is trapped by zombies. Driven to save them, he must navigate this deadly reality and fight for survival-and redemption

metas.name: Odela 2
metas.description: A savior, Odela Mallanna Swamy, protects a village from evil forces.

metas.name: Odum Kuthira Chadum Kuthira
metas.description: Jilted at his wedding, Aby encounters a reserved woman needing help. As they heal together, his ex returns with newfound insight into his dreams. A hidden truth leads Aby to find peace.

metas.name: Officer on Duty
metas.description: A demoted police inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry racket, becoming entangled in a dangerous web of crime that puts his life at stake.

metas.name: Oho Enthan Baby
metas.description: Ashwin goes to actor Vishnu Vishal’s office to pitch a script and ends up narrating his love story. What the actor thinks to be an interval is Ashwin’s climax, it actually is a stoic end to his romantic relationship with Meera. With Vishnu Vishal’s pursual, Ashwin must confront his former lover again, to complete his story and begin his debut directorial.

metas.name: Others
metas.description: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.

metas.name: Paanch Minar
metas.description: When Chotu`s surprise party for his don father ends in tragedy, he inherits the criminal empire and uncovers his uncle Murthy`s deceit. Meanwhile, Kittu, a struggling cab driver pretending to be deaf, becomes entangled in danger after unknowingly helping twin murderers.

metas.name: Padakkalam
metas.description: Four nerdy comic book enthusiasts find themselves in an unexpected adventure when their school's charming new professor turns their academic world upside down with supernatural events.

metas.name: Paramapadha Sopanam
metas.description: Sarpanch, VRO, and medical officer-begin to meet brutal ends, each shrouded in secrecy.Police investigation reveals thirty fingerprints on bodies of deceased, but only one fingerprint is found on the last victim, creating a complex puzzle.

metas.name: Parandhu Po
metas.description: Gokul’s financial reach far exceeds his reality, but juggling unpayable loans and dodging debt collectors, he tries his best to provide for his pampered son, Anbu. With his mother away on business, Anbu persuades his father to go on a motorcycle trip through the countryside – a welcome break from everyday hustle, that helps Gokul realise that his son’s tantrums have a far deeper root than he thought.

metas.name: Paru Parvathy
metas.description: Paru Parvathy is a Kannada road movie about a solo traveler named Payal. The film explores themes of self-discovery, relationships, and emotions. It was shot in multiple locations, including Bengaluru, Goa, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Uttarakhand.

metas.name: Patang
metas.description: Three friends bond and their coming of age graph against a backdrop of kite-flying as a sports event.

metas.name: Pathirathri HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Pelli Kaani Prasad
metas.description: A son's marriage aspirations collide with his father's traditional dowry expectations, leading to a journey of spiritual guidance and family reconciliation.

metas.name: Plot Number 302
metas.description: Shiksha is found hanging, the postmortem report reveals that the girl was HIV positive, investigation reveals that people had declared her characterless without knowing the reason for her illness, now the police have to find out her killer

metas.name: Pongala
metas.description: After being released from prison for a murder he did not commit, a man quickly learns that crime and injustice are still rife in his hometown.

metas.name: Ponman
metas.description: Ajesh,a jewellery agent lends 25 sovereigns of gold to Bruno for his sister Steffi's wedding, only to recover just half. When he demands the rest, he’s drawn into a tense comeback battle with Steffi's husband Mariano, an infamous prawn farmer in coastal Kollam.

metas.name: Pravinkoodu Shappu
metas.description: On a rainy night, a toddy shop owner is found hanging after 11 people stayed inside playing cards in the closed shop. SI Santhosh investigates, uncovering secrets to find the killer.

metas.name: Racharikam
metas.description: Racharikam is a political action thriller set in the crime-infested Rachakonda. The film delves into intense village politics and societal struggles. The movie directed by Suresh Lankalapalli, and features Vijay Shankar, Apsara Rani, and Varun Sandesh in their pivotal roles.

metas.name: Rajini Gaang
metas.description: Rajini and Maina Elope From Their Village and End Up Hitching a Ride With a Stranger And a Petty Thief Whose Stolen Thali They Use for a Hurried Wedding. But Their New Life Takes a Bizarre Turn When Maina Becomes Possessed by the Ghost of Ponnarasi. Seeking Help From a Local Priest, Rajini Discovers That the Spirit Wants Revenge for a Past Betrayal Tied to the Thali. As Twists Unfold, Rajini and His Friends Must Uncover the Truth and Save Maina From the Vengeful Ghost’s Deception.

metas.name: Red Letter
metas.description: When past horrors return to threaten today and tomorrow, confronting society's lingering evil becomes the only path forward. One person, seeking justice and redemption, faces the darkness to stop a monster who escaped punishment.

metas.name: Rekhachithram
metas.description: Having recently served a suspension for gambling online while on duty, Circle Inspector Vivek Gopinath rejoins the police force and is looking to reclaim his lost honour. Awaiting him is a 40-year-old, unresolved murder mystery with a faceless victim.

metas.name: Retro
metas.description: A man with a violent past seeks a fresh start, but the life he left behind resurfaces, forcing him to face old conflicts and redefine his future.

metas.name: Retta Thala
metas.description: Kaali, a struggling Pondicherry orphan encounters his rich Goa doppelganger Malpe Upendra with criminal past, leading to identity swaps and messy consequences. Corrupt cop Thiraviyam and Upendra’s enemies soon conspire to put that to an end.

metas.name: Revolver Rita
metas.description: A woman must use her intelligence and grit to protect her family after they are unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of gang violence.

metas.name: Robinhood
metas.description: Ram, a modern-day Robin Hood, is a master thief who unexpectedly finds himself switching sides. When fate forces him to become the personal security officer for Neera, a rollercoaster ride of action, comedy, and unexpected twists follows.

metas.name: Ronth
metas.description: Two patrol officers face mounting tensions during a night shift as they navigate dangerous calls while confronting their strained partnership and personal demons.

metas.name: Royal
metas.description: Despite busy schedules causing distance, Olivia and Prince Alexander travel to Torovia for Christmas with his family. Clashing cultures between their families lead to various mishaps.

metas.name: Saaree
metas.description: A photographer's obsession with a young woman escalates to dangerous heights.

metas.name: Sabdham
metas.description: A paranormal investigator is employed by a university to investigate a series of mysterious deaths some are attributing to supernatural causes.

metas.name: Sahasam
metas.description: A man betrays his partner and disappears with money stolen from a cartel. Later, when the loot is invested in cryptocurrency, it becomes inaccessible due to a lost password.

metas.name: Sankrathiki Vasthunam
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Santhana Prapthirasthu
metas.description: A journey of facing life’s twists & tests with laughter and love!

metas.name: Sarangapani Jathakam
metas.description: Sarangapani, a man who finds comfort in the guidance of horoscopes, sets off on a turbulent journey that forces him to confront some hard truths about himself and his life.

metas.name: Sarkeet
metas.description: In a distant land, Balu and Stephy struggle to balance work, parenting their spirited son with ADHD, and holding their relationship together. When a worn-out stranger enters their lives, a fleeting connection sparks unexpected change in just one day.

metas.name: Sarvam Maya
metas.description: An atheist priest's life is upended after performing an exorcism, bonding with a charming spirit who helps him pursue music and heal his past.

metas.name: See Saw
metas.description: Inspector Mugilan is a police officer at the Chettipalayam Police Station in Coimbatore.  Aadhavan is a prominent businessman from Coimbatore; his wife is Malavika. The case reaches Inspector Mugilan when Aadhavan’s domestic servant is murdered while Adhavan and Malavika are missing.  The story follows Inspector Mugilan as he investigates the case, uncovering the reasons behind the murder and identifying the culprit.

metas.name: Shakthi Thirumagan
metas.description: A tribal woman is brutally assaulted and killed. Her newborn is mercilessly abandoned in a dump yard, left to die. But fate intervenes — an old man discovers the infant and decides to raise him as his own. The child, named Kittu,After the old man’s death, Kittu is left to fend for himself,determined to confront his mother’s killer.

metas.name: Shambhala HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Shanmukha
metas.description: A police officer and research student explore an ancient Indian temple's mysteries, following scriptures and folklore to uncover secrets about a deity and treasure in a hidden forest location.

metas.name: Shubhchintak
metas.description: Novice Meghna and her two accomplices plot to honey trap Sanjay for revenge, facing humorous and moral challenges. Will she let revenge consume her?

metas.name: Single
metas.description: Vijay, a bank employee, falls in love with Purva at first sight and attempts to get closer to her in hopes of winning her affection. Meanwhile, Harini who secretly harbours feelings for Vijay, begins to follow him—turning his love life into a comedic triangle.

metas.name: Solo Boy
metas.description: After heartbreak, left shattered by love, fate, and betrayal, Krishnamoorthy discovers purpose helping the struggles of Indian farmers. He builds a tech solution that transforms his life and the lives of many, while healing his spirit.

metas.name: Soothravakyam HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Sri Sri Sri Raja Vaaru
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Stephen
metas.description: A psychiatrist evaluating a self-confessed serial killer unravels a twisted web of trauma, deceit, and psychological manipulation—only to question if the killer is truly guilty or just another victim in a larger, darker game.

metas.name: Su from So HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Sundarakanda
metas.description: A man born under the Mula Nakshatra faces misfortune and failed relationships, exploring his journey to win over his ideal match.

metas.name: Surrender
metas.description: A fraught mother-daughter relationship is put to a terrifying test when the family patriarch dies, and the grieving mother hires a mysterious stranger to bring her husband back from the dead.

metas.name: Suryapet Junction
metas.description: A political action drama behind government freebies.

metas.name: Sweetheart
metas.description: A reluctant summer together transforms into an enchanting adventure when a young boy discovers his aunt's mysterious Sicilian house holds secrets and, perhaps, ancient spirits lurking within its walls.

metas.name: Telusu Kada
metas.description: A couple's struggle with infertility takes a complicated turn when an ex-partner offers to be their surrogate.

metas.name: Ten Hours
metas.description: A bus murder investigation unfolds, revealing possible scenarios and suspects. As everyone undergoes questioning, hidden layers of the case begin to surface.

metas.name: Test
metas.description: Sloane and four classmates take cover in Cortege High to escape a world plagued by the infected. As danger relentlessly pounds on the doors, Sloane begins to see the world through the eyes of those who actually want to live and takes matters into her own hands.

metas.name: Thalaivan Thalaivii
metas.description: Two headstrong lovers navigate a turbulent relationship where passion and conflict intertwine, creating an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.

metas.name: Thammudu
metas.description: A troubled man reunites with his sister to protect her and a group of villagers from the brutal plans of a violent criminal businessman.

metas.name: Thanal
metas.description: Fuelled by a lifetime of suffering, an ex army man embarks on a vengeful quest. Standing in his way is a police constable whose own past pain transformed into a dutiful son. When their paths converge, hero either can flee for his life or take a stand against the villain’s scheme of things.

metas.name: Thandel
metas.description: Fisherman Raju is deeply in love with Satya. However, at one point, she urges him to stop going to the sea and look for other jobs. Ignoring her plea, Raju ventures out and accidentally drifts into Pakistani waters, where he is arrested.

metas.name: Thank You Dear
metas.description: Satyam, an aspiring director, and Priya, a strong-willed real estate agent, starts building a new life together amidst love and conflict. But their world is profoundly shaken by a tragic incident, forcing them into unexpected responsibility.

metas.name: The Devil
metas.description: A young woman from the Midwest gets more than she bargained for when she moves to New York to become a writer and ends up as the assistant to the tyrannical, larger-than-life editor-in-chief of a major fashion magazine.

metas.name: The Door
metas.description: Paul and Sophie, interns at a mysterious London firm, become steadily aware their employers Humphrey and Dennis are anything but conventional – they are disrupting the world of magic by bringing modern corporate strategy to ancient magical practices.

metas.name: The Girlfriend
metas.description: A college literature student falls for a charming man with a domineering streak, forcing her to confront the toxic truth of his desire.

metas.name: The Great Pre Wedding Show HDCAM RIP
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: The Pet Detective
metas.description: A couple of amateur sleuths attempt to solve the mystery behind disappearing pets, but become embroiled in far more sinister crimes.

metas.name: Theeyavar Kulaigal Nadunga
metas.description: An Investigative Police officer teams up with an autism school teacher to solve the mystery of a cruel murder happened in a school for autistic children.

metas.name: They Call Him OG
metas.description: Trained to fight in Japan, a man's peaceful life in exile abruptly ends when trouble pulls him back to Mumbai to help those he swore to protect.

metas.name: Thudarum
metas.description: A taxi driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy after his car is confiscated by a corrupt police officer.

metas.name: Thug Life
metas.description: In a world ruled by crime and betrayal, mafia kingpin Sakthivel and his brother Manikkam rescue a young boy, Amaran, during a violent police shootout and raise him as their own. Years later, when an assassination attempt shakes Sakthivel's empire, suspicion turns inward. Consumed by vengeance, Sakthivel sets out to destroy the very family he once built.

metas.name: Thug Life
metas.description: In a world ruled by crime and betrayal, mafia kingpin Sakthivel and his brother Manikkam rescue a young boy, Amaran, during a violent police shootout and raise him as their own. Years later, when an assassination attempt shakes Sakthivel's empire, suspicion turns inward. Consumed by vengeance, Sakthivel sets out to destroy the very family he once built.

metas.name: Tourist Family
metas.description: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

metas.name: Trending
metas.description: Andres, disengaged and apathetic, spends his school days immersed in social media, disconnected from reality. When his brother, Miguel, attempts to halt a bullying incident during lunch, he suffers severe injuries. Instead of intervening, Andres documents the brutal altercation, capturing the harrowing event on his phone, revealing a stark reflection of his detachment from the world around him.

metas.name: Tribanadhari Barbarik
metas.description: Tribanadhari Barbarik (2025) tells the epic tale of Barbarik, grandson of Bhima, who rises in the modern age with his three invincible arrows to fight for the oppressed. Awakened in a world torn apart by greed and war, he is bound by his eternal oath to always stand with the weaker side. As ancient evils resurface and humanity faces its darkest hour, Barbarik must decide whether his power will save the world or lead it into eternal destruction.

metas.name: Tuk Tuk
metas.description: Three teen boys discover a mystical auto-rickshaw that transforms into their village's centerpiece and unexpected hero.

metas.name: Udaala
metas.description: In Bijapur,an orphaned auto driver falls in love and follows a girl into college,where playful revenge against bullies takes many twists—yet can the wisdom of the city’s monuments turn conflict into love,respect,and harmony?

metas.name: Unstoppable
metas.description: With the unwavering love and support of his devoted mother Judy and the encouragement of his coaches, Anthony Robles fights through adversity to earn a spot on the Arizona State Wrestling team. But it will demand everything he has, physically and mentally, to achieve his ultimate quest to become an NCAA Champion.

metas.name: Uppu Kappurambu
metas.description: A fictional village faces an extraordinary crisis as the cemetery runs out of space. Uproarious chaos ensues as the community rallies together, finding inventive solutions to overcome this unusual predicament.

metas.name: Usiru
metas.description: A troubled police officer returns to his full potential when he finds out that his wife is being targeted, travel with him in his journey of saving his wife.

metas.name: Vaamana
metas.description: Explores the emotions and lifestyles of ordinary people, with a compelling hero Guna pursuing vengeance against antagonists. His actions are driven by his past life, which influences his present and future.

metas.name: Vanangaan
metas.description: Trouble follows Kottee, a deaf-mute and hot blooded do-gooder, when he gets a job at a special home for the underprivileged and his quest for justice leads him into conflict with the law and strains his relationship with his sister, Devi.

metas.name: Veera Dheera Sooran part 2
metas.description: Kaali is a provision store owner and a loving husband and father, is brought back into the life of crime, when his former boss's son is being hunted by the police.

metas.name: Veera Dheera Sooran Part 2
metas.description: Kaali is a provision store owner and a loving husband and father, is brought back into the life of crime, when his former boss's son is being hunted by the police.

metas.name: Vidaamuyarchi
metas.description: While struggling with his broken marriage, Arjun is pulled into a desperate search for his wife, Kayal, when she goes missing during a road trip.

metas.name: Vidhrohi
metas.description: Folder: South_Indian

metas.name: Vritta
metas.description: Vritta centers on siddharth a quiet, withdrawn man whose life takes a dark and twisted turn after one impulsive decision.One night. One unexpected phone call. One wrong turn. And that’s all it takes to spiral into the unknown. What begins as a simple night drive unravels into something far more disturbing — a haunting journey through isolation, guilt, and fractured realities. As the silence deepens and the night stretches on, siddharth finds himself trapped in a circle he can’t escape. A circle called vritta.
